newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH KOMERCNI MANDATES 5-YR REVOLVING CREDIT.
newsitem.headline: CZECH KOMERCNI MANDATES 5-YR REVOLVING CREDIT.

text.p: The largest Czech commericial bank, Komercni Banka a.s. said on Monday that it had awarded four international banks its mandate to arrange a five-year 250 million mark revolving credit line.
It said in a statement that the bank's include BZW, Dresdner Bank Luxumbourg SA, Sanwa Bank Ltd., and Union Bank of Switzerland.
It said the credit would be priced at 20 basis points above the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR) in the first three years, and 22.5 basis points above LIBOR in the fourth and fifth years.

"The named group of arrangers, which has underwritten the entire amount, will soon contact a small group of selected banks with an offer to join the syndicate, and then approach others interested," Komercni said.
It said the mandate was awarded last week.
Komercni carries a long-term indicative rating of Baa2 from Moody's, A-minus from the IBCA, and BBB-minus from Standard & Poor's.
